decision: Named the working product Resonote and started a new repository
why: The name supports music plus writing without claiming an available domain

decision: Chose Next.js App Router with demo-local and optional Supabase modes
why: Public share pages need server routing while zero-key demo mode keeps setup from blocking review

decision: Made backslash-triggered music references explicit and user-confirmed
why: Silent title matching is ambiguous and violates user agency

decision: Rebuilt the application after the working container discarded the first uncommitted tree
why: Preserved the agreed architecture and committed milestones early so a second environment reset could not erase the run

decision: Used UUID-shaped seed identities and isolated demo and Supabase persistence modes
why: The same product graph can run without credentials and later sync without mixing local demo state into production state

decision: Made every inline music mention a first-class reference with its own identity, relation, and lenses
why: Two mentions of the same entity can mean different things and connections remain human-authored rather than inferred

decision: Applied stable geometry, preserved drafts and focus, serialized repeated writes, and tied motion only to semantic state
why: The product must feel physical: one deliberate action changes one bounded region without incidental layout movement

decision: Kept one persistent player and used documented YouTube and Spotify iframe control paths
why: Route changes and pause/play should not remount the media surface or make controls report false state

decision: Kept listening history private while leaving public journals, likes, pins, and collections shareable
why: Listening events are more personally sensitive than authored public taste and should not leak through profile bundle loading

decision: Added reversible personal genre assertions with creator provenance
why: People need to express their own taxonomy without overwriting catalog metadata or pretending community judgment is authoritative

decision: Replaced incorrect seed release-group identifiers with verified MusicBrainz release groups
why: Cover art and external metadata must point to the conceptual album rather than an unrelated or pressing-specific record

decision: Ran offline syntax, strict shim typecheck, runtime catalog, data graph, whitespace, stability, and static responsive layout checks
why: The container could not reach npm, so claims are limited to checks that actually ran and networked package gates remain explicit
result: offline gates green; npm gates pending

decision: Prepared a full-history Git bundle and source archive instead of claiming a GitHub push
why: The connected GitHub tool can inspect repositories but cannot create one or upload local Git objects, and gh is unavailable
